name: Grand Resonance Core
description: The Grand Resonance Core is the central void‑arcane engine that powers Ka Vethan’s infrastructure, rituals, and Praesertum authority. Stabilizer rings, resonance pylons, void‑arcane conduits, and Luclinite latticework channel immense energy throughout the city. Only the highest Akhevan custodians may approach the Core, and even they do so with caution.
